label: Daily Flap Rename
info:
Renames your SurePetcare cat flap every day with a randomly chosen dramatic name, so you get messages like 'Minoes left through the Gates of Valhalla'.

## Setup
1. Configure the surepetcare-config node with your credentials
2. Set the Device ID in the surepetcare-control node (numeric ID from GET /device)
3. Deploy and click the inject node's button to test it immediately
4. The flow fires automatically every day at 00:01

## Notes
- All names are phrased to read naturally in '$cat left through $name'
- If you have multiple flaps, adjust the Device ID in the control node to target a specific one
- 'Skip If Curfew Active' polls 'Check Curfew' (a one-shot surepetcare-devices read, pollInterval 0) and cancels the rename if any device's configured curfew window currently covers the trigger time. This isn't a leftover caution - the rename endpoint (PUT /device/{id}) has been observed to reset the flap's lock as a side effect, even though locking isn't part of the request. At 00:01 that side effect lands squarely inside most curfew windows, silently dropping whatever protection - including a full both-ways lock applied by escalation flows like examples/curfew-full-lock.json - was active at the time. The check reads the curfew schedule itself (lock_time/unlock_time) rather than the device's live lock state, so it still catches an already-escalated full lock, which a state-based check would miss
- With multiple flaps, the curfew check runs per device but the rename always targets the single Device ID configured on 'Rename Flap' - if one flap's curfew is active it will hold back a rename meant for a different, curfew-free flap too. Split into separate rename flows per device if that matters for your setup
